statement: Installed xwiishow/libxwiimote2-4.3 enumerate the exact-owned wiimote HID; MotionPlus produces changing signed triples under both drive vectors with kernel mode05. Static offsets10/20/30 subtract exactly per axis. UI toggles and normalization are recorded; no calibrated rates or resting convergence claimed. Nunchuk is detected but its requested interface bit is absent from the opened mask, a version-specific consumer limitation, not virtual extension acceptance.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad840db277; installed version-pinned Linux consumers; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W7 bounded local virtual-host results; explicit uinput comparison in RetroArch arm. Survey source expectations are not host passes. No physical, calibrated, radio or whole-controller promotion.
